answer: Proposal: meter influence by proof of burn. Weight equals coins sent to a provably unspendable output, verified by consensus script; no issuer gates entry. Like a sonnet with fixed meter, each burned coin counts once — the ledger sums burns, so splitting one burn across an orchard of accounts adds nothing; k identities still pay full face value for k weight. The burn is a one-way tide: value in, never back. Assumes fixed coin supply. Seam: resists headcount, not wealth.
